Cookie Policy

Current cookie use

Sicilia Bella's website does not currently use advertising cookies, analytics cookies or behavioural tracking cookies. We do not currently run Google Analytics, Meta Pixel or similar tracking tools on this website.

Essential website technology

Our hosting and security infrastructure may use technical mechanisms necessary to deliver, protect and operate the website. These are not used by Sicilia Bella for advertising or profiling.

External websites

The website links to services such as Google Maps, Google Reviews, Instagram and Facebook. When you choose to visit those external services, they may use cookies or similar technologies under their own policies. Those cookies are controlled by the third party, not by Sicilia Bella Ristorante.

Why there is no cookie banner

Because this website is currently configured without non-essential tracking or advertising cookies, we do not display a consent banner solely for unnecessary cookies. If non-essential tracking is added in future, we will update this policy and introduce an appropriate consent mechanism before that tracking is activated.

Contact

Questions about this policy can be sent to siciliabellamgarr@gmail.com.
